parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

*   zh: Chinese
*   en: English

parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of the destination cluster.

parameters.name: VersionCode
parameters.description:
The destination version number.

> You must call the GetImage operation to obtain the maximum destination version number that corresponds to MaxVersionCode.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun mse update-image --cluster-id mse-8e8e9060 --version-code ZooKeeper_3_5_5 --accept-language zh --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun mse UpdateImage --region cn-hangzhou --VersionCode ZooKeeper_3_5_5 --ClusterId 'mse-8e8e9060' --AcceptLanguage zh
